description: This file defines a static class 'StreamInstruments' that contains metrics instruments such as counters and gauges for monitoring stream-related activities within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods to register observers for certain gauges.

classes.name: StreamInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing metrics instruments for stream monitoring within Orleans.
